bio:
I'm Kadir Lofca, I worked on products with 2M+ users, won an IEEE award, and founded Sentzel. 

My work is an extension of my life philosophy — shape your environment, shape yourself. I curate my surroundings, think in systems, and engineer habits to set myself and my work up for success. 

I believe the first step for fulfillment is investing in the body and mind. I love cooking healthy meals, bouldering, and working out. I also love traveling to see unique architecture.
